method: Each of the 63 source requirement cards is evaluated against current product/domain code, dedicated test evidence and retained live evidence. Contract-member counts are not used as requirement coverage. PARTIAL means a related domain capability exists but the source acceptance chain (visible result -> requirement -> Knowledge Layers -> evidence -> model/rule version -> human decision when applicable) is not proven end to end.
